subject: connect to database which requires VPN

messages.author: f8c0b2c9588a19eb
messages.subject: connect to database which requires VPN
parts: In shinyapps, how can I connect to a database which requires VPN connection ?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] connect to database which requires VPN
parts:
I am not sure this is something that we support at this time. My recommendation ask your network administrator to allow access to your database from shinyapps.io servers. This can be restricted by IP address or AWS security group if you're running on EC2.


Thanks
-Andy
